summary: This is an ordinary note offering filing under Item 8.01. PayPal issued $2.0B in senior notes across three tranches: $650M 4.550% notes due 2028, $850M 4.950% notes due 2031, and $500M 5.550% notes due 2036. The offering was conducted under a shelf registration statement. No special-situation event such as merger, tender, or restructuring is present; it is a routine debt capital markets transaction.
